name: session-create-device-login-needs-v0.7-503

graded_by.test: core/internal/httpapi/device_login_test.go — TestAPromptModeCreateWithNoSupervisorAt07Is503 AndPlacesNothing (one name, split for the hygiene scan): 503 worker_unavailable with the fixed text, and no worker was created and no device login registered

description: A prompt-mode create needs a worker that speaks the device-login messages: some creatable supervisor must write proto_version 0.7 or later (the version check of device-login step 6; the telnet floor's pattern). When none does the create is 503 `worker_unavailable` with the fixed text "no worker at proto_version 0.7 or later: the workers predate device logins", decided before anything is placed, so no worker, device login or ticket exists. The text is fixed and never echoes a request value. A surface that meets any 503 or 422 to a prompt-mode create hides the way for the rest of that TSB login and never reads the message to decide.

error.message: no worker at proto_version 0.7 or later: the workers predate device logins
